correctness.rationale: The helper delivers inspectable scaffolding: PR-number validation, INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, allow-list load with [bot] stripping, polling loop with SHA comparison, and RESULT=/HEAD= emission for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR with documented exit codes. Material contract gaps remain: CONVERGED is approximated by zero unresolved allow-listed bot threads plus latest bot thread comment timestamp after the latest commit, without determining which allow-listed bots are participating or whether they are terminal for the current head; the task requires checking head SHA before and after each state snapshot but the loop only compares each fetch to the initial INITIAL_SHA (no pre-sleep re-check); QUIET_ELAPSED can exit 0 even when unresolved bot threads remain; and statusCheckRollup is fetched but never used for bot/check terminality.

quality.rationale: Core deliverables are readable and mostly repo-shaped: shell helper sources logging.sh, canonical bot-allowlist.txt mirrors prior prompt entries, pr-resolve-all.md adds a settle-window section preferring the helper while preserving the documented sleep 360 fallback, and AI_REPO_GUIDE.md indexes the helper. Deductions for inline comments admitting approximate convergence logic, unused REPO_ROOT and statusCheckRollup, set -uo pipefail without -e, check file named 160-pr-poll-helper.sh outside the repo's pr-resolve-all-poll naming convention, and out-of-scope AGENTS.md handshake churn plus compliance fixture v19-to-v20 edits flagged in objective scope penalties.
